basic_info.description: Nestled at the desirable Outer Sunset. This Charming single family home boasting 1423sq.ft. offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bath, partial ocean view, updated kitchen, and baths.  The main level welcome you a spacious living room w/ wood burning fireplace, office/bonus room, two bedrooms, full bath, kitchen/dining area, and a powder room. The updated kitchen presents white shaker style cabinetry, quartz countertop, and a complete set of SS appliances. The lower level boasting two spacious guest bedrooms, a full bath w/ shower over tub, and a family room featuring a wet bar. The cozy backyard offers an intimate atmosphere for your backyard entertainment or private oasis.  Centrally located near Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, schools, parks, shops, and public transportation.
